name: dobe_join_mouth
desc: Edit only the mouth area of the doberman head. Draw the closed mouth corner the same way as the reference doberman: the end of the mouth line lifts up slightly, and a little apart from it a short cheek crease (wrinkle) is pushed up, showing a restrained sly smirk. No cartoon arrow or < mark. Keep the eye hidden. Keep everything else exactly the same: head shape, ears, body, arm, goo, colors, outline, size and position.
